title: Book Two · Chapter 175: The Final List
story:
The final shortlist goes up on Tuesday. Three names appear beneath the Thursday time. Ronan's name is not there.

He knew it would be missing. He still reads from the top to the bottom twice.

Leo. Mei. A girl from another reading table.

The girl stands beside him with her friend. She points to the time, then checks a note in her book. She looks nervous. She has a real chance at one of the two places.

Ronan moves aside. There is still space by the wall. But he does not want to look at the list again.

At lunch, a boy asks about the list.

“Were there not four before?”

“There were,” Ronan says.

“What happened to yours?”

Ronan puts down his spoon. He can say that the teacher made a mistake. That is true, but it is only part of the answer.

“Leo helped me with one task,” he says. “The table said I did it alone. I showed Miss Wu the original page. My real total is three.”

“Did you write the wrong total?”

“No. But I saw it last week. I did not tell Miss Wu until yesterday.”

The boy looks at him, then at the food. “That is a hard way to miss it.”

“Yes.”

The boy does not call him brave. He asks Leo about the Thursday time. Ronan picks up his spoon again, but his food is cooler now.

After lunch, Mei stops him outside.

“Miss Wu explained the correction,” she says.

Ronan looks down at her folder. He can see a corner of her clear notice inside it.

“You will do well,” he says.

“I hope so. I still need to do the tasks.”

“I know.”

She wants to ask something else. He can see it in her face. At last she says, “Are you coming to the yard?”

“Later.”

“All right.”

She goes to meet Jun. Ronan stays under the roof until the crowd at the wall is gone. He reads the final list once more from a distance.

On his way home, he buys no bun. He keeps the small coin in his pocket and walks past the stall. At the green door, Mum is waiting with a basket of clean cloth.

She sees his face and puts the basket down.

“The list?”

He nods.

She holds out her arms. Ronan is taller now, and he has to bend a little. He puts his forehead against her shoulder for a moment.

Then they carry the basket inside together. She asks no more questions until he is ready to answer them.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

nervous＝紧张的；from a distance＝从远处；forehead＝额头；shoulder＝肩膀。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样向同学完整解释自己没有进入最终名单？
2. Mum给他的安慰具体是什么？

## 读句子

**She holds out her arms.**

拆开看：She / holds out / her arms.

她／张开／双臂。
